$comment: Output contract for POST /v1/plan (WA-02, issue #74, docs/WORK_ORDER_WA_02.md). Same structural boundary as interpret-schema.json/audit-schema.json: there is no field here that could authorize a mutation, run SQL, or reference an id the model was never given -- `steps[].tool` is a closed enum of generic, already-existing Family Finance tools, and `steps[].arguments` is a flat string-only bag the deterministic backend (app.services.assistant_tools) re-validates per tool, re-resolves against real household data, and may still reject or ask for clarification even when this schema accepts it. The model plans which tools to call and with which free-text hints; it never computes a financial total and never receives one back to recompute -- see app.services.assistant_orchestrator for the full re-validation/execution boundary. `additionalProperties: false` throughout means an attempt to smuggle an authority-shaped field (e.g. `account_id`, `amount`, `sql`, `confirmed`) is a schema violation, not a warning.
